embedding_description: Push one caller-side summary chunk for a session into the M6 search index. Generates an embedding via embedding_service, stores it via vector_service, then inserts the session_ledger__summary row. Used by auto_summarize cron + operator-side lift verbs (lift_codex_stage1_summaries) to make session summaries searchable via search_sessions.
